:::{#exm-ci-diff-means}

#### Confidence interval for the male-female birthweight difference at 40 weeks

For the `birthweight` model with an interaction (`bw_lm2`),
the code below applies @thm-ci-diff-means to the difference between males and females at 40 weeks,
using the estimated covariance matrix of the coefficients.
As a check, it refits the model with age centered at 40 weeks,
where the `sex` coefficient is exactly this difference:

```{r}
#| label: exm-ci-diff-means-calc
#| code-fold: show
ex_pair <- data.frame(
  sex = factor(c("female", "male"), levels = levels(bw$sex)),
  age = c(40, 40)
)
ex_design <- model.matrix(delete.response(terms(bw_lm2)), ex_pair)
ex_delta_x <- ex_design[2, ] - ex_design[1, ]
ex_est <- sum(ex_delta_x * coef(bw_lm2))
ex_se <- sqrt(drop(t(ex_delta_x) %*% vcov(bw_lm2) %*% ex_delta_x))
ex_tcrit <- qt(0.975, df = bw_lm2$df.residual)
ex_ci <- ex_est + c(-1, 1) * ex_tcrit * ex_se

ex_bw_centered <- transform(bw, age_c = age - 40)
ex_fit_centered <- lm(weight ~ sex + age_c + sex:age_c, data = ex_bw_centered)
ex_ci_refit <- confint(ex_fit_centered)["sexmale", ]
```

The estimated difference is `r round(ex_est, 1)` grams,
with 95% confidence interval
(`r round(ex_ci[1], 1)`, `r round(ex_ci[2], 1)`).
The refitted model gives
(`r round(ex_ci_refit[1], 1)`, `r round(ex_ci_refit[2], 1)`),
which agrees.

:::
